Hi Amir and Sana —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. Before we lock in calendars for the POC kickoff, I want to align on two things so we don't have last-minute reschedules:

1) Who needs to attend the first 90-minute session (AE + SE + customer engineering + procurement + security)?
2) Which two-week window in Dec/Jan gives everyone at AtlasPay the best chance to finish the procurement checklist so the kickoff can include SSO and audit scope?

Suggested attendees from our side:
- Olga Petrov (AE) — agenda + success criteria owner
- Dylan Brooks (SE) — demo and environment onboarding
- Karthik Iyer (Solutions Manager) — billing/procurement liaison

I've attached a short success-criteria draft and a first-pass SOW to speed approval. Can you confirm internal attendees (engineering lead + security reviewer + procurement PO) and give two date ranges that work? If it's easier, share a single calendar invite with a 2-hour block and we'll adapt.

Next steps I propose after attendee confirmation:
- We send a 90-minute kickoff invite with prework and access instructions.
- We lock an internal two-week window for access handoff and a cutover dry-run.

Thanks,
Olga

olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

- Suggest alternate (give 2 options)
- Decline (include who will deputize)

- 0–15m: introductions + success criteria walkthrough (Olga)
- 15–60m: environment access + demo (Dylan)
- 60–80m: procurement/legal checklist and timeline (Karthik)
- 80–90m: owners & next steps + scheduling the two-week ramp

If Dec 29 works, I'll also block a follow-up 2-hour session on Jan 5 (technical handoff / SSO + secrets) and a dry-run on Jan 12.

Olga
